notes.title: New Release Window Trailer!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44528050/cbbdf308437ec1d019f165b612f9fa50b1fcd817.png[/img]

Hey all!  I know it's been quiet for Towerbolt the last while here, but I now have some big news and a new trailer to share!  Check out the new release window announcement trailer here: 

[previewyoutube=b17QYqNP1xI;full][/previewyoutube]

For those wanting the big news without watching the video, the game will be releasing [b]THIS YEAR[/b]!  I have been hard at work to push towards finishing the development of this game over the last few months, and am happy to share a brief glimpse into the full game here.

The steam demo for Towerbolt has been updated with some minor changes as well!  The playable content is the same as older steam demos, but if you'd like a taste of the early gameplay with some updated visuals, please take a look!

I'm pumped and excited to be nearing the last leg of the journey for this game.  Please wishlist and share! 

It's Time to Break Free!

-bordenary
